purpose: Relocate the completed FININ study into its own project without adding any LLM project files or changing scientific evidence.
historical_path_rule: Saved relative paths resolve from this project root in the relocated checkout. Historical Git revisions and source snapshots retain the original root-level layout and bytes.

verification.comparison_method: Compare each pre-relocation Git blob with its staged relocated blob; reject any change outside the listed documentation/attribute files. The requirements edit corrects a documentation link only.

local_only: Original research artifacts/data moved with the FININ project and remain ignored. Existing workspace-root .venv and tmp are legacy ignored tooling; new clones create project-local environments.
